invariants.rationale: Ensures the metadata object passed is not null, reflecting standard method expectations and precondition for successful operation.
getWriteStatuses() is called within the method, so the collection should not be null.
getPartitionToReplaceFileIds() is passed into buildMetadata, so should not be null for correct operation.
setCommitMetadata is called with Option.of(value), so Option should be present after the method executes.
The size of a List is always non-negative as a general Java collection property.
